title: Helion Energy careers band
description: A one-window call to action that darkens as it scrolls in: the page colour gives way to a near-black ground lit by soft pale spotlights from the bottom corners. A small 1.48 film sits in the middle with a short tight heading to its left and an outlined button to its right; phones stack them centred under a mono eyebrow. The button's outline opens from the middle as it arrives and its label rolls on hover.
notes: always dark (its content and ground carry the `dark` class); the ground fades in with a CSS view timeline and is simply dark without one
the spotlights use the theme's dark `glow`
media is the small film; empty, a dark placeholder
